integrity: The statement follows from a symbolic characteristic-three root-sum lemma and quotient-fiber count; exact modular tests provide finite checks, not the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted orthogonal three-character spectra of pairs of three-point sets in elementary abelian ternary vector groups only; no Riesz-basis, arbitrary-characteristic, cyclic prime-power, or approximate-frame assertion. Earlier equivalent affine-design enumeration not absolutely excluded.
title: Exact common orthogonal spectra for pairs of ternary Fourier triples
